sorry_base: theorem sorry_base (n : Nat) : n = n := by sorry
dependent: theorem dependent (n : Nat) : n = n := sorry_base n
trusted: theorem trusted (n : Nat) : n = n := by rfl
shape: theorem shape {α : Type} (f : α → α) (P : Prop) (h : P) [Nonempty α] : ∀ x : α, ∃ y : α, y = f x := by sorry
function_definition: def function_definition (n : Nat) : Nat → Nat := fun x => n + x
